SpoolTags._comment: Imports the SpoolmanDB filament catalog daily. For offline work set CatalogFilePath to a local copy of filaments.json.

TagReader._comment: How the native app derives MIFARE Classic sector keys. Real values go only in your untracked appsettings.Development.json (see the spool tag spec) and, in production, App Service settings such as TagReader__Formats__0__Params__saltHex. Copy _example into Formats to enable it. Schemes: hmac-sha256-sector (saltHex, labelPrefix, sectors) and hkdf-sha256-sectors (saltHex, infoHex, sectors).

Params.saltHex: <set locally; see the spool tag spec>
Params.labelPrefix: <set locally; see the spool tag spec>

Webhooks._comment: Add a key (openssl rand -base64 32) to try webhooks locally; empty leaves them off. AllowPrivateAddresses lets them reach a Home Assistant on your LAN or in Docker, and works only in Development.

Email._comment: Leave Enabled and DryRun false unless you are working on email. Keys: openssl rand -base64 32. See docs/email-runbook.md.
Email.PostalAddress: PO Box 0, Example City, ST 00000, USA
